# sed.fyi

> Open-source development tools built for the modern web.

sed.fyi is a collection of developer tools and utilities created by Greg Nazario.

## Projects

- [Move Playground](https://move-playground.sed.fyi): An interactive playground for the Move programming language. Write, compile, and test Move smart contracts directly in your browser with real-time feedback and syntax highlighting. Built with TypeScript, React, Move, and WebAssembly.
- [Secure Pastebin](https://pastebin.sed.fyi): Share files securely with post-quantum encryption. Features ML-KEM (Kyber) + AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption, Argon2id password protection, and decentralized storage on Shelby Protocol. Built with TypeScript, React, and Post-Quantum Cryptography.
